description: WINDOWS ONLY (build.rs). Tauri on Windows treats only http://<protocol>.localhost as the app's own origin; a per-document origin http://bento.<24 hex>.localhost is 'remote' and is refused every custom command unless a remote capability says otherwise (measured on WebView2). This admits exactly the host's three commands to exactly those origins. Every one of them still demands the load's capability secret; no core or plugin permission is granted.
